parsed.study_design: Municipality-level quantitative impact analysis using observed and simulated tariff scenarios
parsed.population_and_sample: Domestic water and waste service users in mainland Portugal; all 278 municipalities for water provision and wastewater treatment, 258 for waste management, with 101 municipalities included in the detailed water social-tariff comparison.
parsed.exposure: Actual municipal social tariffs and simulated implementation of ERSAR Recommendation No. 1/2009, compared with a no-social-tariff baseline.
parsed.outcome: Social-tariff coverage and take-up, subsidy volume and subsidy per beneficiary, and bill increases for non-beneficiaries, addressing household affordability and financial access to water services.
parsed.rationale: Sections 5–6 (pp. 13–17) identify the administrative tariff exposure, data sources, domestic-user population, comparison scenarios, and quantitative methodology. Section 7 and Tables 6–7 (pp. 18–22) report empirical affordability-related outcomes, including beneficiary numbers, take-up rates, subsidy amounts, and bill accruals under actual and recommended social-tariff schemes.
